name: intelligent-college-timetable
description: Intelligent college timetable generation and optimization platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @timetable/api" "npm run dev -w @timetable/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @timetable/api && npm run build -w @timetable/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @timetable/api && npm run test -w @timetable/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @timetable/api && npm run typecheck -w @timetable/web
